text_block_list.text:
"Today is all about letting Vivlos 
unwind." Ever since making that decision, 
I had put together a plan to make sure 
Vivlos had the absolute best time today.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
We got on the carousel super smoothly~, 
and took some totally gorgeous pics for 
Umastagram~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eeeh♡ What are we doing next, Trainie~♪
choice_data_list: Of course, whatever you desire.
Of course, whatever you desire.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~â¡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So if I say I wanna go to the pool right 
now~, will you make it come true?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go!
Yeah, let's go!

text_block_list.text:
No matter the season, you won't get cold 
here. I guide Vivlos to the heated pool.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Wahhh~♡ Hey, hey, next is that waterslide 
over there! I wanna ride it, I wanna ride 
it~!"
choice_data_list:
I thought you'd say that, so I made a 
reservation.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: One step ahead○~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha. Aweeeesome. You're amazing, 
Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Everything today has been sooo fun! Ever 
since you asked me to hang out, all of it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
This feels totally high-class~♡ There's 
someone to prepare everything for us~♪
choice_data_list: Tsk, tsk, tsk... We're not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eeeh? No way, no way, no way~?

text_block_list.name: Driver in Black
text_block_list.text:
Lady Vivlos. Trainer. We have prepared a 
car for your return.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehhh!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Genius! Trainy, you're super amazing! A 
shiny car is waiting for us! Hey, hey. 
We're riding home in this?
choice_data_list: Ah, was that a nice little break?
Yeah, did that help you unwind?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It has! Way too much! To think it'd be 
like this...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I feel like a celebrity♡

It seems the plan I prepared for Vivlos, 
right down to the main event saved for 
last, was a complete success.
choice_data_list: (My wallet's a lot lighter now, but...)

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Boy's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Are you all right? How badly does your 
stomach hurt?"

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Dad. What should I do? The roads are so 
jammed, they said it'll take 50 minutes 
for a taxi to arrive...

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... I'm sorry, Dad. Mom. It's all my 
fault...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainy.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Can I ask you one last favor?

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, thank you so much! I'll gladly 
accept the ride! And in such a magnificent 
car, too... Um, how much do I owe you...?
choice_data_list: No, no, please just hurry on for now.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Nihehe. Thanks, Trainie.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
She looked like her stomach hurt, and she 
seemed so frustrated saying "sorry." I 
just couldn't help it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...It was such a fun day, so suddenly 
making everyone worry and feel sad... 
well, it would turn into a painful 
memory."
choice_data_list: …You're so kind, Vivlos.
…You're so kind, aren't you, Vivlos.
Did something like that happen to you too?
Did something like that happen to you too?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...It was such a fun day, so suddenly 
making everyone worry and feel sad... 
well, it would turn into a painful 
memory."
choice_data_list: …You're so kind, Vivlos.
…You're so kind, aren't you, Vivlos.
Did something like that happen to you too?
Did something like that happen to you too?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, really~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Buuut maybe it's all thanks to you, 
Trainy? I've had sooo much fun with you! 
♡"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I wanna ride in a super celebrity-looking 
car, but... ...I guess just for today 
would be fine~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I know you'll make the walk home super fun 
even without a car, Trainie♡
choice_data_list: ...What?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe♪ Next, I wanna do this!

Just then, slender arms wrapped around my 
neck, and a warm weight pressed against my 
back.
choice_data_list: Vivlos, what's this...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehe♡ I wanna piggyback ride home♪
choice_data_list:
...You might hit your limit pretty soon, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Still, you'll give it your best right up 
to your limit, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "...Ehehe. I loooove you, Trainy♡"

In the end, the power only lasted a 
moment... ...Yet Verxina smiled, looking 
completely content.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. You caught me? It just... happened 
a lot, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Only when I'm having fun with my family.

text_block_list.name: Young Cheval
text_block_list.text: "...Vivlos, does your tummy hurt? If so—"

text_block_list.name: Young Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"—! No, don't do it! It's fine. I can hold 
it in!"

text_block_list.name: Young Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...B-Because... Cheval-chi and Big Sis 
were really looking forward to today's 
play..."

text_block_list.name: Young Cheval
text_block_list.text: "......Verxina."

text_block_list.name: Young Cheval
text_block_list.text:
"But if you do that, it won't be a happy 
memory for Vivlos either. ...Ugh, Daddy! 
Mommy!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, with family, it feels like 
nobody can really have fun unless everyone 
in the family is doing well."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm sorry, Trainy. After you went 
through all the trouble of preparing the 
car for us.
choice_data_list:
It's fine, I got to see you looking so 
cool

It's fine, I got to see you looking so 
cool

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "...Wah. Cool? I looked cool~!? Eheh~♪"

As she hopped around happily, she looked 
even more magnificent than usual that day.
